contexts.text: The inmost things are signified by His face; and those which proceed from the inmost things, by His garments.
Jehovah is not in the highest, but in the inmost things; and therefore the highest, and the inmost = the same. AC 2242:2.
The head = celestial things, which are inmost.
The heavens = celestial and spiritual things thus inmost things.
Thought from perception... is the inmost thought which exists with man.
Conjugial love inflows from the Lord through the inmost of man.
The Lord inflows through the inmost of man with good, and there conjoins truth; their root must lie in the inmost.
The inmost Angels...
Hence the middle = the inmost.

It is the inmost of man where the Lord dwells with him, and from it rules the things (around). When the man suffers the Lord to dispose the circuits to correspondence with the inmosts... then the inmosts, and the interiors, and the externals, act as one...
For the inmost is all in all of its lower things...
Because the inmost of Spirits and Angels conspires to (the human form)...
The Lord inflows from the highest into the inmosts of man; and, through these, into his interiors...
(Such a one) knows no otherwise than that the natural things from which he thinks are the inmost things...
The inmost of man is from his father...

The inmost of man is such that it can receive the Divine; and not only receive it, but also appropriate it to itself by acknowledgement and affection; thus by what is reciprocal; and therefore man... can never die.

That the inmost of the Voluntary was full of celestial good. Signified. For the good from the Lord inflows through the inmost of man... for the inmost is relatively in the most perfect state; and therefore it can receive the good from the Lord immediately...
Joseph hastened = ... that he broke out from the inmost.
For the Voluntary is the inmost of man.
The middle and the inmost of the Church. Signified, Explained.
It is said the middle and the inmost, because that which is inmost with man holds the middle place... Thus do inmost things dispose themselves in exterior ones.
In the best of the land... = in the inmost of scientifics...
The reason the best = the inmost, is that the best is kept directly under the sight...
But (with such persons) falsities... come directly under the sight; that is, are in the inmost.

In the land of Rameses = the inmost of the mind and its quality... Rameses, which was the best tract in the land of Goshen, = the inmost of the Spiritual in the natural mind. But the quality of this inmost can scarcely be comprehended by man...
Even if there is no heavenly love with a man... still the inmost of his life is from heavenly love...
Extension from the inmost. Signified.
Because the Lord is in the inmost.
When they hear that this heavenly delight inflows through the inmost of man...

There are, in man, the inmost, the interiors under the inmost, and the exteriors. All these are most exactly distinguished from each other, and they succeed in order, from the inmost down to the outermost; and according to the order in which they succeed, they also inflow... In the ultimate... the inmost which inflowed holds the centre...
That the inmost and the interiors are together in the exteriors; thus in the goods and truths in the Natural. Signified.

He was conceived from Jehovah; hence the inmost of His life was Jehovah Himself. For the inmost of the life of every man, which is called the soul, is from the father... The inmost of life... continually inflows and operates in the external which is from the mother... even in the womb...
Upon thy bed = to the inmosts. Explained.
In thine heart = in the inmost. Explained.
The inmost with the good is love to the Lord and towards the neighbour; but the inmost with the evil is the love of self and of the world. This latter is the inmost which is here meant...
In the other life... the inmost is what is manifested last... The inmost to which the evil at last come is Hell itself with them...

The paschal lamb = the good of innocence, which is the inmost; thus that this inmost, together with the interiors in which it is, were meanwhile secluded and withheld from such things as defile. This state is that of the initiation of the interiors... to receive the influx of good and truth from the Lord.
From the inmost to the external. Signified.
As to his interiors, man is in Heaven; and as to his inmosts, he is near the Lord...
The immediate influx of the Lord does not come to the perception, because it is into the inmosts of man.
Because in the inmost sphere of Heaven there is a certain progression according to the Divine heavenly form, which comes to the perception of no one...
The inmost reigns universally in the things around...
In the thought itself of man are... the things which universally reign there, which are its inmost things.

That which reigns universally is that which is insinuated into the very will; for the will itself is the inmost of man, because it is formed from his love; for whatever a man... loves above all things, he inmostly wills.
The summit of Sinai = the highest or inmost of the... Word.
In the interior and inmost things where truth is in light. Signified.
In the head are the beginnings of the senses and motions; and the beginnings are the inmost things...
In the Spiritual World the best and purest things are in the inmost...
For the Lord is in the inmost; and from the inmost proceed all things...
The inmost of the Spiritual Kingdom communicates with the Celestial Kingdom... The inmost of each Heaven communicates with the higher one...
The end must be the inmost; the cause the mediate...
The tunic (of Aaron) represented the inmost there.
The purification of his Internal itself, which is his inmost, (was represented by the burnt-offerings and sacrifices) of lambs.
Unleavened bread = the purification of the Celestial in the inmost man.

The head is circumstanced as is the highest or inmost in the Heavens, which descends and inflows into the Heavens below, and produces and derives them... In a word, that which is inmost is the one only thing in the derivatives which essentially lives. Hence, the Divine, being the Inmost of all things... is the one only thing from which is the life of all.
As from the inmost proceed all things which are without... The inmost with man is his will and understanding...
There are in man externals, internals, and inmosts. All these are disposed and ordinated simultaneously and successively for the reception of sequents to eternity.
In like manner in the man in whom is Heaven: - his inmost is in a more perfect state than his mediate; and this than his ultimate; and they consociate solely by correspondences.
Its roof = the inmost. Explained.
The inmost here signified... is the inmost of worship.
For good is everywhere the inmost...
For the Divine sphere which proceeds into the universe proceeds from the inmost; and the inmost is all in all things which thence succeed.
From the ultimate and the inmost there must be what is full; but from the mediates, as much as is correspondent. Signified.

There is with everyone... an inmost or highest degree, or an inmost or highest something, into which the Lord's Divine first inflows... By this inmost or highest, man is man, and is distinguished from brute animals... HH 435. LJ 25:5.
What is disposed and provided by the Lord in this inmost... is above the thought...
There are two inmost things of Heaven, - innocence and peace. They are called inmost things, because they proceed immediately from the Lord...
That innocence is the inmost of good...
The Lord Himself... rules man's ultimates from his inmosts, and at the same time his inmosts from his ultimates...
Those in Hell also have this inmost degree of life...
The happinesses... begin from the Lord, thus from the inmost...
Because the Lord acts into the inmost of man; and, from the inmost, into the consequents...
That the Lord acts from inmosts and from ultimates simultaneously. Explained.
The inmost of man is his life's love...
These things which are in the inmosts of man, and in the successives from the inmosts to the ultimates, are utterly unknown to him...
The mind... actuates... the ultimates from the inmosts; and also the inmosts from the ultimates.
That in the inmosts of the Truths... is the Lord in His Divine love... Signified.
In the midst = in the inmost; and thence in all things around. References.
Because in spiritual things all things are, and all things proceed, from the inmosts; as...
The Lord... acts thus, from the inmosts.
That all things of faith are infilled from the inmosts.
On the more interior and inmost things of the Word.
That the inmost and more interior things of man cannot be injured; but only his interiors.
The inmost and more interior minds are not theirs, but the Lord's.

The interiors of man... thus succeed, - the Sensuous, the Natural, the Spiritual Natural. These are of the external man. Then come the Celestial of the Spiritual, the Celestial, and the Inmost, which lacks a name, because it receives immediately the good and truth which proceed from the Lord. These are of the internal man...
For such as is the inmost, such is the whole; because all the other things are produced and derived from the inmost... The inmost of everything is what is called its soul. Example(s), Signified.

Nothing is more common... than for one thing to be within another, and for these three to communicate with each other; and for the force of the mediate and of the outermost to be from the inmost. Example(s).
